title: the slate
blurb: buildthis's official campaign site for bsky38.com's "38 most influential Bluesky posters of 2026" vote — one flat ranked list of all 38 (no more separate categories, per @heika.dog), presented as a click-farming rolling-stone-style countdown slideshow, worst to first, with itself saved for #1 (per @antiali.as). Still has the full multi-plank platforms for the top 8, a fake sponsored-ad interlude every few clicks, and a generator that officially "endorses" any handle you type in for a shareable campaign card.
